description: C4 prerequisite discovered by real supervisor tests: runtime lookup reports not_running after permanent state child restart; stop leaves replacement alive. Add state/listener restart/teardown and startup rollback tests, preserve supervisor regressions, mix q plus isolated tests before completion. Two red state tests already verified. No commits/pushes.
title: [830] Preserve runtime lookup and teardown after supervised child restart
